name: claude2_1_325_shell_write_to_protected_path
description: Claude Code 2.1.325 Bash call captured from a real run with a capture-only hook. The command is relative to cwd and writes the protected file. The CLI updates itself, so a claim must name the version the payload was captured at. Version 2.1.325 adds the top-level scratchpad_dir field, which 2.1.321 did not send.

capture.sanitisation: session/prompt/tool-use ids replaced with cap-* markers; the workspace directory collapsed to /cap, transcript_path and scratchpad_dir replaced with /cap placeholders; basenames, parameter names and casing preserved exactly as emitted
